caption: The drawing depicts a colored illustration of a decorated ceramic bowl with several different views and details. At the top center, there is the inside view of a shallow bowl with a brown rim, featuring a bird standing amid foliage painted in earthy tones of brown, ochre, and green. Around the rim, there is a German inscription written in a blackletter script. The bowl has a missing section, which is shown by the irregular break on the right side. To either side of the top view, there are two detailed renderings of floral motifs in green, orange, brown, and red, corresponding to decorations from the side of the bowl. Below these, there is an underside view of the same bowl, showing a bird next to a floral motif, along with green leaves, orange flowers, and a basket-like shape, all painted in earthy and muted colors. The circular base of the bowl is depicted in dark brown. Beneath the underside view, there is a simple line drawing of the bowl’s profile, providing a plain structural outline. At the bottom right, the name “Charlotte Angus” is inscribed, indicating the artist of the drawing. The entire composition is set against a plain, beige background.
title: Pa. German Shaving Basin
